newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSA CONSIDERS OWN LITHUANIA BRANCH.
newsitem.headline: HANSA CONSIDERS OWN LITHUANIA BRANCH.

text.p: Hansapank said on Tuesday that it would probably be easier to open its own branch in Lithuania, where it wants to expand its operations, than buying a bank in the local market.
"At the moment it seems that opening a new office would be a better prospect," Hansapank chairman Juri Mois told a news conference.
Hansapank is already present in Latvia through Hansabank-Latvija. It has a leasing business in Lithuania, which Mois said was now the market leader there.
Mois said it would be better to open Hansapank's own Lithuania branch as the privatisation of state banks was taking too long.
Mois said Hansapank wanted to start banking operations in Lithuania as soon as possible.
